title: Estate dry run — {{tree}}
subtitle: Fold this tree over every active block and cell in one tenant. Writes no card.

tenant.label: Tenant
tenant.hint: Whose blocks and cells are folded. The tree itself may be the platform's.

required.body: Choose a tenant. A platform account has no blocks of its own, so there is nothing to fold until one is named.

state.runningBody: The run is still folding. This page asks again every 3 seconds.

empty.body: This tree has no estate dry run yet. Run it to produce a report.

rules.title: Combination rules
rules.composed: Composed text on {{pct}} of the cells that produced a card.
rules.allComposed: No rule fired on any cell. Matching is exact, so a set with one extra code goes to composed text.

errors.title: Errors by node
errors.some: {{cells}} cells errored, {{pct}} of the cells evaluated. Read the node list before switching this tenant on.
errors.blocking: {{cells}} cells errored, {{pct}} of the cells evaluated. A switch on a missing index stops the walk, so those cells get no card at all.

timing.title: Timing
timing.includes: Includes the per-block data loads, as the sweep does.
timing.noNodeTiming: Time per node is not measured. The walk has no timing hook and the per-cell fold does not return the node path.

results.title: Run results — {{tree}}
results.subtitle: What real runs of this tree produced, by block and finding set.
results.empty: No run of this tree has written a trace yet.
results.error: The run results could not be read.
results.stageC: A dry run writes no trace. Rows appear here after the tree is added to the sweep.

errors.startFailed: The run could not be started.
errors.readFailed: The report could not be read.
errors.treesFailed: The tree list could not be read.
